name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
label: Quest
description: Strength of Mount Mugamba: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Master friend, you return! Molthor has sent word of your deeds to the King. Your name is known even in the South Seas. Perhaps one day you will be a legendary adventurer - a story for the ages.
Give me your talisman so that I may once more amplify its power.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Use your newfound strength to destroy the Gurubashi!
